snippet.title: Maestro : All Aboard!
snippet.description:
All Aboard! The new Maestro DLC is live! 🦜 

Featuring iconic themes from "Pirates of the Carribean" by Hans Zimmer: "He's a Pirate" and "Jack Sparrow", viral sea shanty "Wellerman" and more...

Conduct at sea, where weather and tide change with the music, summoning the Kraken and the Flying Dutchman to join your performance to your audience's delight! 🦑 

Fortune be with ye, cap'n Maestro! 

https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/all-aboard/1310468043816380/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4197260/Maestro_All_Aboard/

Tracklist : 

🏴‍☠️ He’s a Pirate (from Pirates of the Caribbean) – Zimmer & Badelt 
🏴‍☠️ Jack Sparrow (from Pirates of the Caribbean) – Zimmer 
🏴‍☠️ Wellerman – Unknown
🏴‍☠️ The Shipwreck (From Scheherazade)  – Rimsky-Korsakov
🏴‍☠️ A Sea Symphony (Overture) – Vaughan-Williams

And remember Capt’n: an ❌ sharp always marks the spot!
